database_coverage_cautions.evidence_context: No linked_sequence_records rows are present locally; compound identity is supported by primary article structure/prose and linked DBAASP peptide name, not by a database sequence snapshot.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The primary article gives an exact AGS IC50 and an overall five-line IC50 range, while local Figure 3 is a 20 µM inhibition-rate bar chart without machine-readable target-specific IC50 values for BIU87, BEL-7402, HepG2, or B16.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: DBAASP target-specific non-AGS IC50 values are preserved as source_conflict/database-only exact annotations; final activity rows use only the primary-supported AGS exact value and the primary-supported panel range.
